summary: Opened an authority-transition variant of the witnessed decided-index regression: because stopsign_is_decided requires decided == accepted, a node that decided a StopSign and then applies a reconnect AcceptSync with a lower decided index should report is_reconfigured() as None until re-decision. Added two StopSign sources (state_cache stopsign_is_decided, sequence_paxos is_reconfigured), an unresolved source account, and a five-node experiment: entries 1–4 decided, a StopSign decided only on node 5, node 2 elected at decided 4, node 5 reconnects via reconnected(2), sampling is_reconfigured before/after/after re-decision. The fan-out duplicate/skip finding and all prior records stand; this experiment is pending.
